propositions: _assemble_context_uncached silently swallows list_tickets and per-child show_ticket failures with a bare except Exception, leaving children empty
PlanContext.has_children returns False when children enumeration fails completely, causing container-scoped DET checks like p5_task_dag to return trivial pass instead of reporting incompleteness

finalize_verdict must be called at five sites across workflow_ops.py and gate_dispatch.py, but currently only two sites can access real pctx hierarchy state; threading requires coverage dict propagation and YAML edit

hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail flags must be added to PlanContext, retried reads must set them on failure, and finalize_verdict must map hierarchy_incomplete=True to INDETERMINATE verdict
plan_review_precheck_output.schema.json must declare hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail as optional object properties to allow schema-valid step output recording

No relevance-exception carve-out applies because failed enumeration suppresses the very container-scoped criteria that would need the missing context, making the exception trigger condition unstatable
